recent_posts: The peso is at 61.8 per dollar, its weakest level in the past year. Five days now without a move beyond 0.25%, but viewed annually, it is 7.3% weaker than a year ago.

The rupiah stands at 17,857 per dollar, its strongest level in the past 61 days. Year to date the currency is still down 6.15%, though it has moved within a tight 1.7% range over the past 30 days.

The rupee against the dollar is steady at 277.6, no significant change over the past week. It has not moved more than 0.25% in the past 13 days, and the rupee is up 1.1% since the start of the year. #Pakistan $PKR
